problems: The blind guess ('unrecognisable', faint segments with no object) does not match The Tally Kite. Only the tail reads as a zigzag chain, and the kite itself is not identifiable.

The kite is far too small and cramped in the upper right (roughly x 390-435, y 215-340). Top spreader (~412,218), left wingtip (~394,237), bow-knot (~423,246) and right wingtip (~434,245) sit within about 40px of each other, so the kite has no readable diamond or cross-spar shape.
The bottom tip (~417,340) is joined to the first knot by a long line, but the kite body and tail are not clearly separated by a proportioned silhouette.
The tail knots are crowded: the second and third knot labels (~255,340 and ~234,343) overlap each other and the first-knot label, so their order is hard to verify.
Labels overlap heavily: 'left wingtip', 'bow-knot', 'right wingtip' and 'top spreader' run into each other and are clipped at the right edge (e.g. 'the end of', 'the crown of t').

The figure is drawn almost entirely as gold joining lines with only faint pale-blue segments behind them. No filled or outlined silhouette is visible, so it reads as a copy of the gold lines rather than a real shape.
Stray unlabelled background stars (~200,136), (~84,182), (~376,215) and (~447,315) sit near the figure and may be confused with kite parts.
Orientation is roughly correct (kite head up, tail trailing down-left), but the tail's overall length and direction do not clearly read as a kite tail.
output.advice: Scale the kite up so it spans a clear area, for example 150-250px wide and 200-300px tall, and keep the top spreader at the top, the wingtips at the left and right ends of the cross-spar, and the bow-knot at the spar intersection. Move the bottom tip to the lower point of the diamond. Space the cross-spar wider so the wingtips and bow-knot do not overlap. Lay out the tail as a visible, gently curving chain of knots below the bottom tip, with knots 1 to 4 and the end knot spaced far enough apart that their labels do not collide. Draw a filled or outlined pale silhouette for the kite body and tail, not only the gold connecting lines. Shorten or offset labels with leader lines, and keep them inside the frame. Remove or dim stray background stars that sit close to the figure.
